name: Flowise
shortDescription: Open-source, low-code builder for LLM flows you can self-host.
longDescription: Flowise is a low-code builder for LLM flows. The npm package and GitHub repo are the open-source path we could confirm. The pricing page came back thin in our crawl, so a cloud free tier is not confirmed. We did not install it.
pricingNotes: npm view flowise version=3.1.4. Hands-on install not run.
bestFor: Visual flows on infrastructure you run yourself
Teams already comfortable with a Node service
notIdealFor: A confirmed free hosted plan — we could not verify one
Code-first agent libraries, if that is all you need
strength: The open-source npm package flowise 3.1.4 is a low-code builder you can self-host.
weakness: The pricing page came back too thin to confirm a cloud free tier.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Open-source low-code builder for model flows you can self-host.
